summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd., appointed Mr. Wei Jiang as executive director (succeeding retiring Ms. Xiao Fu), elected Ms. Li Jiang as employee director, and accepted the resignation of Mr. Liang Chang as executive director due to personal career planning. All changes took effect May 11, 2026. No terms, prices, or advisors provided. This is a routine board succession at a listed subsidiary, not an abrupt forced departure. While classified as management changes, the event is procedural and low-conviction. No special situation triggers beyond standard director transitions.
